dominant_strengths: Authentic Apple typographic system with confident SF weights, clear hierarchy in nav, and bold editorial 'Get the highlights' headline.
Sticky product nav with underline active state and pill CTA reads as native, polished, and behaviorally familiar.
Hero image carries chromatic-aberration craft detail that adds visceral texture against the otherwise sterile white canvas.
dominant_weaknesses: Mid-scroll capture shows awkward layout: large empty band above headline and overlapping caption text on the model image breaks composition.
Caption typography 'An exceptional spatial listening experience...' feels stranded, mis-scaled, and competes with the figure rather than framing it.
Footnote marker '.2' collides directly with body copy with no superscript treatment — a craft regression uncharacteristic of Apple.
fix_priorities: Re-anchor the headline and hero so vertical rhythm collapses the dead space and the caption sits in a defined safe area.
Treat footnote references as proper superscripts and tighten caption width for editorial restraint.
Strengthen carousel affordance (pagination dots) with clearer active state and motion cue.
Introduce subtle tonal background shift to separate hero card from page chrome.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral familiarity leads, visceral polish follows via imagery, but reflective payoff is muted because the storytelling layout falters mid-scroll.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads convincingly as an Apple AirPods Pro 3 scroll moment, but a transitional frame exposes layout seams rather than the brand's usual seamlessness.
